languageIntro: A little competition. A lot of good company.
consentBody: No account needed. Your games and stats stay on this device. This preview uses simulated ads and purchases, with no advertising SDK collecting data.
consentNote: Live Android ads require Google’s consent form. Change your choices anytime in Settings.
roundNote: Teams rotate once per turn; turns are not rounds per team.
classicDesc: A set number of turns. Highest score wins.
streakDesc: Find five to stay in. Last team standing wins.
emptyPool: Select a category and an owned pack with enough questions.
duplicateTeams: Give every team a different name.
handoffBody: Keep the answers away from the Guesser. Read aloud, then tap each answer they find.
jokerSub: Choose one before starting. Each is usable once per team.
rewardBody: This is a simulation, not a live ad. Complete the demo to receive one extra joker for this team.
question: Reader view
readerOnly: Only the Reader should see this screen
pauseBody: Take a breath. Keep the answers hidden.
endBody: You keep your points for the answers already found.
leaveBody: Your current game will be lost. Completed game stats stay saved.
step1Body: One teammate holds the phone and reads the question aloud. Only the Reader sees the answers.
step2Body: Name the nine answers before the clock runs out. The Reader taps every correct answer.
step3Body: Each answer earns 1 point. All nine earns 3 extra. A hidden tenth answer can be a bomb: −5 and the turn ends.
jokerRules: +2 adds two points. ×2 doubles your answer score and all-nine bonus. Bombs subtract 5 after scoring; the penalty is never doubled. Swap uses a fresh question.
tieRules: Tied leaders get a sudden-death question each. Equal sudden-death scores produce shared winners.
settingsSub: Make it your kind of party.
resetBody: Current-game questions will still never repeat.
noStatsBody: Finish a game to start collecting your stats.
shopSub: A bigger question box for your next get-together.
devPrices: Illustrative prices, not Google Play prices. Purchases and restore are local simulations.
remove_adsDesc: Remove every banner, interstitial and rewarded ad. Extra jokers remain available in the shop.
pack_footballDesc: Club nicknames and stadium clues for your football table.
pack_moviesDesc: Nine TV titles at a time. A pack for your watchlist experts.
pack_tunisiaDesc: Explore Tunisian governorates and their capitals.
bundle_allDesc: All three packs and no ads, in one bundle.
jokers_packDesc: Five one-use bonus jokers, shared across your games.
purchaseBody: Choose a store outcome to test the complete flow. No payment will be taken.
purchasePending: Purchase pending. Nothing is unlocked until payment is confirmed.
purchaseFailed: Purchase failed. No charge was made. Please try again.
purchaseCancelled: Purchase cancelled. No charge was made.
restored: Local development entitlements restored. This does not query Google Play.
interstitialBody: Every third completed game gets an ad here, never during a question. This preview shows no real ad.
rateBody: After five finished games, you can leave a review. The store listing must be published first.
poolEmptyBody: This game has used the selected question pool. The game will finish without repeating a question.
saveError: Storage unavailable. Changes stay in memory until the app closes.
privacyText: Placeholder policy — replace before publishing. Tissa requires no account. Team names, preferences, question history and statistics are stored locally. This development preview does not connect to an advertising or billing service. A production version may use Google AdMob, Google UMP and the Android advertising ID to serve and measure ads according to your choices. Google Play processes payments; Tissa should receive purchase tokens, never card details. Remove Ads disables all advertisements. You can manage consent and clear question history in Settings. Contact: privacy@example.com. Designed for ages 12+. Last updated: November 2026.
termsText: Placeholder terms — replace and obtain legal review before publishing. Tissa is a family-safe pass-and-play trivia game. No account, gambling or cash prizes. Content is for entertainment; report factual errors to support@example.com. Purchases in this preview are simulated. In production, non-consumable products and refunds follow Google Play policies. Consumable jokers are spent when used. Store pricing and availability may vary by region. Local data may be lost when uninstalling. All rights to original Tissa content reserved.
skipHint: The question swaps immediately; then you can start normally.
extraHint: Use an extra to reuse a spent scoring joker.
